content:
Vanessa Tavares represented BUILT CoLAB at Porto Business School, giving a seminar on the “Leading for Sustainability” module of the Sustainability in Real Estate executive course, at the invitation of Bento Aires, director of the program.

During her presentation, Vanessa Tavares addressed the issue of sustainability assessment and reporting in construction companies, focusing on the European Taxonomy and ESG Reporting in companies in the AEC sector.

This executive training is aimed at senior executives, company managers, project managers linked to the real estate and construction sectors, as well as architects, engineers, sustainability consultants, or project managers operating in the real estate sector. During the programme the participant is given the opportunity to become the differentiating element of the organization and to be the driver of sustainability, of the organization’s new strategic values.

For BUILT CoLAB this was another opportunity to be in contact with the various players in the construction industry, and to continue with our mission of promoting the digital and ecological transition in the AEC sector, so we thank you for the invitation.
